row.title: AI-GOV-ACCOUNT-1: static per-worker AI shares refused calls with half the account's neurons unused
row.body: Each worker planned against a static share of the day in its own ledger while the console and site shares sat idle. The tick now sizes its allowance from Cloudflare's account-wide neuron count (aiInferenceAdaptiveGroups, sampled every tick) minus its own use; the static share is only the fallback. Measured 2026-11-21 over 24 h: 9,645 neurons account-wide, KV reads 116k (free 100k a day), D1 reads 5.7M (free 5M a day), requests 98.6k (free 100k a day): the free plan binds on four meters at once.
